environment: local repository snapshot; no deployed URL
applicability_reason: Static source review found no enabled nonessential SDK, but hosting, CDN, media, forms and analytics can add terminal technologies only observable in the deployed runtime.
expected: A deployed per-state inventory identifies every cookie, storage entry, request and third party; nonessential technologies remain blocked until any required consent and withdrawal controls are valid.
observed: The repository keeps analytics disabled and browser smoke saw zero external resources on the tested local page. No deployed URL or four-state runtime inventory exists.
method: Static dependency/code review and local browser resource smoke; deployed-runtime collection was not possible.
preconditions: No production hosting, CDN, form, media or analytics provider is configured.
limitations: Local code cannot reveal technologies injected by future infrastructure or providers.
not_tested_reason: There is no deployed runtime on which to inventory cookies, local/session storage, pixels and third-party requests across consent states.
impact: Undetected nonessential technologies could store or access terminal information before a valid user choice and make withdrawal ineffective.
prevalence: Every deployed route and every hosting, CDN, media, form, messaging and analytics integration.
priority: P0 before deployment or provider activation

source_refs.legal_effect: Regulates storage of or access to information in a recipient's terminal equipment within scope, subject to statutory conditions and exceptions.
source_refs.instrument: Ley 34/2002, de servicios de la sociedad de la información y de comercio electrónico
source_refs.version: BOE consolidated text; last update observed 2025-01-23
source_refs.applicability_reason: The final deployed web stack may store or access terminal information; current absence cannot be inferred from source alone.

false_positive_analysis: Zero external resources in the local smoke and no enabled analytics are counterevidence to current source-level tracking, but not to future provider injection.
counterevidence: The tested local home page loaded zero external resources.
remediation_minimum: After infrastructure and providers are selected, capture an inventory in no-choice, reject, accept and withdraw states; classify each technology and keep nonessential access blocked until the approved mechanism allows it.
additional_hardening: Automate a network/storage diff in release QA and rerun it after every provider or tag change.
suggested_owner: Privacy owner, frontend engineering and infrastructure
effort: Low to medium after a staging runtime exists
retest: Capture cookies, storage and requests in all approved consent states on the exact deployed release.
residual_risk: NO-GO for tracking or provider activation until the deployed inventory and consent behaviour are verified.
